en: We see particle-like behavior every day: drop a ball on the ground and it follows a single
zh: 我們每天都能看到粒子般的行為：把球扔到地上，它會沿著單一

en: trajectory, leave your giraffe parked on the street and when you come back, it's still there, just one giraffe.
zh: 軌跡運動；把長頸鹿停在街上，當你回來時，它還在那裡，只有一隻長頸鹿。

notes.example: How come you didn't text me back?

en: And we see wave behavior, too!
zh: 我們也觀察到了波動現象！

en: Toot your horn, and waves spread out through the air, carrying sound to the ears of anyone around.
zh: 鳴笛，聲音會傳遍空氣，傳到周圍每個人的耳朵裡。

en: Or drive a boat through water, and waves travel outwards along the surface.
zh: 或駕駛船隻在水中航行，波浪會沿著水面向外傳播。

en: But when it comes to the physics of the very small, what we see is a wave-particle duality.
zh: 但當涉及到微觀物理學時，我們看到的是波粒二象性。

en: Sometimes very small things (we're talking electrons & protons here) behave like particles, and sometimes they behave like waves!
zh: 有時，非常小的東西（ 這裡指的是電子和質子）會表現得像粒子，有時它們表現得像波！

en: For example, if you release an electron, it'll travel outward as a wave through the room,
zh: 例如，如果你釋放一個電子，它會像波一樣向外傳播穿過房間，

en: but when it hits the wall, it'll only hit in one place - you started with one electron, after all!
zh: 但當它撞到牆上時，只會撞到一個地方——畢竟，你一開始只有一個電子！

en: So what if sound had a wave-particle duality?
zh: 如果聲音具有波粒二象性呢？

en: When you shouted, the sound waves would spread outwards in all directions, but only one person could hear what you said!
zh: 當你大喊時，聲波會向四面八方擴散，但只有一個人能聽到你說話！

en: Or when you drove your boat through the water, the waves would travel like normal, but only hit the shore in one place!
zh: 或者當你駕駛船隻在水中航行時，波浪會像往常一樣傳播，但只會擊中岸邊的一個地方！

en: Now that would make for some pretty boring surfing!
zh: 這樣一來，衝浪就太無聊了！
